papers.title: A semi-analytical thermal modelling approach for selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Structural Optimization and Mechanics Group, Department of Precision and Microsystems Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime and Material Engineering, Delft University of Technology, Mekelweg 2, 2628 CD, Delft, The Netherlands

corresponding_authors.name: Can Ayas
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Structural Optimization and Mechanics Group, Department of Precision and Microsystems Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime and Material Engineering, Delft University of Technology, Mekelweg 2, 2628 CD, Delft, The Netherlands

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注选择性激光熔化的热建模方法，未涉及生物医用植入物的力学性能或结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a thermal model for SLM process but does not address stress shielding, LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立选择性激光熔化过程的热模型以预测温度分布
summary_zh.method: 提出半解析热建模方法，结合解析与数值计算
summary_zh.result: 模型能准确预测SLM过程中的温度场
summary_zh.validation: 通过与实验或仿真数据对比验证模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient thermal model that accurately predicts temperature distribution during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A semi-analytical approach combining analytical solutions with numerical integration is proposed to model heat transfer in the SLM process.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves accurate temperature predictions with significantly reduced computational cost compared to full numerical simulations.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against experimental measurements or high-fidelity simulation results for single-track scans.

papers.title: Rapid Discharge in Total Hip Arthroplasty: Utility of the Outpatient Arthroplasty Risk Assessment Tool in Predicting Same-Day and Next-Day Discharge
papers.first_author_affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstructive Surgery, NYU Langone Orthopedics, NYU Langone Health, New York, New York

corresponding_authors.name: Ran Schwarzkopf
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Division of Adult Reconstructive Surgery, NYU Langone Orthopedics, NYU Langone Health, New York, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文完全关注全髋置换术后出院时机的临床预测，不涉及任何生物力学或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no contact mechanics, no FEA, purely clinical discharge protocol.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测全髋置换术后快速出院的可行性
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性收集患者数据，验证门诊关节成形术风险评估工具
summary_zh.result: 该工具能有效预测当天或次日出院

summary_en.motivation: To assess the utility of a risk assessment tool in predicting same-day and next-day discharge after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Prospective data collection from THA patients and validation of the Outpatient Arthroplasty Risk Assessment Tool.
summary_en.result: The tool effectively identified patients eligible for rapid discharge.
summary_en.validation: Clinical cohort validation with prospective data.
